title: Truck spills nails, screws on U.S. 285 near Morrison, over 50 vehicles damaged - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Braithwaite ,
4 hours ago Featured image for Truck spills nails, screws on U.S. 285 near Morrison, over 50 vehicles damaged The drivers of over 50 vehicles reported damage after a semi-truck spilled boxes of nails and screws onto U.S. 285 westbound near Morrison Tuesday afternoon, authorities said.
Troopers were called to the area near the Morrison Exit just after noon Tuesday, and were able to stop the truck and contact the driver, as well as others that had sustained tire damage, according to a Wednesday evening news release from Colorado State Patrol.
Officials received calls from over 50 drivers affected by the incident throughout the day and into Wednesday, according to the release. They were given insurance information to file a claim with the truck’s company.
The truck’s driver fully cooperated with the investigation and has not been charged as of Wednesday evening, according to the release. The Colorado Department of Transportation responded to the area and cleaned the debris from the highway.
Anyone or was affected by the spill or has information about someone else who was is asked to contact Colorado State Patrol at 303-239-4501, with reference case number 1A261639.
